verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit and MCP server document a reporting tool (`list_transaction`) and access to "transaction details" through pre-built functions, so an agent can pull transaction data. Nothing documents payout or settlement data for bank deposits, or a way to map each bank deposit to its underlying charges. The Payouts API covers sending money to recipients, not settlement deposits. missing for 10: documented bank-deposit/settlement payout data via API, deposit-to-charge reconciliation linkage, balance-transaction fields documentation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
